channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Waterfront Florida development uses Live Local Act to bypass local zoning rules
item.description: A large waterfront development project in Florida is moving forward under the Live Local Act, allowing it to avoid local zoning regulations.

item.description: Teens from anti-drug coalitions across the country joined grieving parents and federal law enforcement at the Fentanyl Free America Summit in Orlando this week. item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts qualify for Junior Olympics after top 15 national finish
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month, qualifying the team for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Downtown Delray Beach launches Wellness Pass with free fitness classes and spa deals for July and August
item.description: The Delray Beach Downtown Development Authority launched the Downtown Delray Wellness Pass for July and August. The mobile-exclusive pass allows users to access complimentary classes, discounted wellness treatments and promotions from participating businesses.

item.title: Palm Beach County Food Bank serves 2,500 hot meals daily to children at 35 summer sites
item.description: The Palm Beach County Food Bank in Lake Worth Beach supports more than 35 Summer BreakSpot sites across Palm Beach County, serving approximately 2,500 hot meals each day to nearly 1,250 children while school is out for the summer.

item.title: Palm Beach Zoo extends Kids Free promotion through Aug. 10, announces koala joey name
item.description: The zoo's popular Kids Free promotion has been extended through Aug. 10. Up to four children ages 3 to 12 receive free admission with the purchase of one adult ticket.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs Blue Angels Pensacola low-altitude flyover as Pentagon dismisses safety reviews
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said low-altitude military flyovers will continue after a Navy Blue Angels jet buzzed a crowded Pensacola beach Wednesday, sending chairs and tents flying.

item.title: Murray Middle School demolition begins in Martin County after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Demolition is underway at Murray Middle School in Martin County, starting a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage from Hurricane Milton.

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff intensifies traffic enforcement with deputies targeting speeders
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer, deploying additional deputies and launching a new targeting initiative aimed at reducing speeding and reckless driving across the county. item.title: Fort Pierce woman wins $5 million from $20 scratch-off ticket
item.description: Maria Duran claimed a $5 million top prize from a Florida Lottery scratch-off game in April.

item.title: JetBlue ending direct flights from Vero Beach to JFK Airport in September
item.description: JetBlue is ending its direct flights between New York's JFK Airport and Vero Beach Regional Airport, citing low passenger demand for the route that launched in December.

item.title: Treasure Coast Traffic Report: Major I-95 Ramp Closures Planned July 19-24
item.description:
Motorists across the Treasure Coast could encounter delays during the week of July 17-24 as construction and maintenance continue on several major roadways.
